description: This Java class 'OrderEditor' facilitates serialization and deserialization of the 'Order' object for web forms or other media, including retrieval by ID and UUID.

classes.name: OrderEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for converting between Order objects and their string representations, supporting lookup by ID and UUID.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves an Order object by its internal integer ID using the OrderService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an Order object by its UUID string using the OrderService.
